subject: Fix double-promotion compilation error in test_util.cpp (#4624)
reason: The change touches only the unit test file src/unit/test_util.cpp, changing a NaN-producing literal from double (0.0/0.0) to long double (0.0L/0.0L) to fix a double-promotion compilation error in the test build. No server, command, replication, persistence, or tool code is modified, so there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
